explication: cloc is a command-line source-code counting tool. A user points it at files, directories, archives, or a Git commit; cloc counts blank, comment, and code lines and presents per-language results. The README excerpt documents this workflow but does not expose implementation details, so the internal stages below are conceptual and share the supported `cloc` path; no unverified module calls are shown.
